# Third-party components

## ByteTrack

`bytetrack/` contains the project's adapted C++ ByteTrack implementation.
Upstream: [ifzhang/ByteTrack](https://github.com/ifzhang/ByteTrack).
The original MIT license is preserved in [bytetrack/LICENSE](bytetrack/LICENSE).
Adaptations include class propagation, score fusion and configurable tracking thresholds.
No precise upstream revision was recorded in the original project.

## ONNX Runtime

Download the platform-appropriate 1.19.2 distribution from the
[official release page](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/releases/tag/v1.19.2).
Its headers and library binaries are external dependencies and are not included here.
Preserve the notices supplied with the downloaded distribution.
